modules.title: 哪一列能唯一确定一行

example.label: 用户表里定位并核对一行

steps.label: 先看完整表格
steps.demo:
users · 更新前
idnameemailcity
7小林lin@example.com杭州
8林晓lin@example.com苏州
9陈雨chen@example.com厦门
steps.caption: 这张 users 表中两个账号碰巧有同一个邮箱。主键 id 各不相同，因此可以唯一选中目标行；邮箱不是本表主键。

steps.label: 按重复邮箱更新
steps.demo:
UPDATE users SET city = 'Hangzhou'WHERE email = lin@example.com
匹配结果id 7 和 id 8 · 共 2 行
风险两个人的资料都可能被改
检查：SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'lin@example.com'; 结果：7, 8 · 暂停更新，缩小条件
steps.caption: 如果更新条件是这个邮箱，会匹配到两行；在执行前先核对匹配行数，不能假设邮箱唯一。

steps.label: 按主键更新并复查
steps.demo:
users · 更新后复查WHERE id = 7 · 匹配 1 行
重新读取的相关行
idemailcity
7lin@example.com上海
8lin@example.com苏州
id 8 未被修改
steps.caption: 限定 id = 7 后，再查看受影响行数并重新读取整张表：id 7 的城市改变，id 8 保持原值。主键提供唯一标识，但是否恰好更新一行仍要看实际条件和结果。

modules.title: 主键为什么必须是唯一的

items.title: 定位一行，而不是一批
items.text: 主键值能唯一定位行；实际更新还要检查 WHERE 条件、受影响行数和重新读取结果。重复字段作为条件可能匹配多行。

items.title: 普通字段会重复
items.text: 同名、同邮箱完全可能出现；主键的值不允许重复，也不允许为空。

items.title: 表之间的关联靠它
items.text: 订单表记录“属于哪个用户”时，存的就是用户表的主键，而不是姓名。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 主键保证唯一，不保证正确。出现两条看起来重复的数据时，先弄清为什么重复——可能是重复录入或迁移出错，而不是先删掉一条。

lessonPractice.title: 一张用户表里想按“邮箱”更新某人的资料，但表里有两个相同邮箱。问题出在哪？

options.label: 邮箱在这张表里会重复；用表中已定义的主键 id 唯一定位目标行
options.feedback: 对。这张表的邮箱有重复值，按邮箱更新会匹配多行；id 是表中定义的主键，可唯一定位目标行。

options.label: 随便更新其中一行，影响不大
options.feedback: 改错行意味着改了别人的资料；定位必须唯一。

options.label: 先把重复邮箱的记录都删掉，只留一行
options.feedback: 删除数据是危险操作；先弄清为什么重复，再决定合并还是修正，而不是直接删。

en.title: You want to update someone's profile by email in a user table that has two identical emails. What is the problem?

options.label: This table has repeated emails; use its defined primary key id to identify the target row
options.feedback: Correct. Emails repeat in this table, so an email condition matches multiple rows; id is this table's designated primary key and identifies the target row.

options.label: Update any one of the rows; the impact is small
options.feedback: Editing the wrong row edits someone else's data; location must be unique.

options.label: Delete all duplicate-email records first and keep one
options.feedback: Deleting data is dangerous; find out why duplicates exist and decide to merge or fix, not delete.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请按主键更新这条用户记录，不要按邮箱或姓名定位。更新前先告诉我匹配到几行；如果多于一行，停下来说明情况再继续。改完后重新查询这条记录确认改动。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Update this user record by primary key, not by email or name. Before updating, tell me how many rows match; if more than one, stop and explain before continuing. After the change, query the record again to confirm.

learning.assumes: You have seen table data, or AI mentioning updating a record by id.
learning.outcome: Given a table, you can point to the column that uniquely identifies a row and explain why the others cannot.

modules.title: Which column uniquely identifies a row

example.label: Locate and verify a row in a users table

steps.label: Read the full table first
steps.caption: Two accounts in this users table happen to share an email. Their primary keys, id values, differ, so each can identify one row; email is not this table’s primary key.

steps.label: Update by the duplicate email
steps.demo:
UPDATE users SET city = 'Hangzhou'WHERE email = lin@example.com
Matchesid 7 and id 8 · 2 rows
RiskBoth people's records may change
Check: SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'lin@example.com'; Result: 7, 8 · stop and narrow the condition
steps.caption: An update condition using this email matches two rows. Check the matching row count before writing; do not assume that email is unique.

steps.label: Update by primary key and recheck
steps.demo:
users · verify after updateWHERE id = 7 · 1 matched row
Read the affected rows again
idemailcity
7lin@example.comShanghai
8lin@example.comSuzhou
id 8 was not changed
steps.caption: After limiting the condition to id = 7, check affected rows and read the table again: id 7 changes city, while id 8 stays the same. A primary key uniquely identifies a row, but still verify the actual condition and result.

modules.title: Why a primary key must be unique

items.title: Locate one row, not a batch
items.text: A primary key uniquely identifies a row; still inspect the write condition, affected-row count, and read-back result. A repeated field can match multiple rows.

items.title: Ordinary fields repeat
items.text: Identical names and emails happen all the time; a primary key's values cannot repeat and cannot be empty.

items.title: Tables link through it
items.text: When an orders table records which user an order belongs to, it stores the users table's primary key, not the name.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A primary key guarantees uniqueness, not correctness. When two rows look duplicated, find out why first—duplicate entry or a migration error—rather than deleting one.

distinctions.label: Index
distinctions.text: An index is a structure that speeds up lookups and does not guarantee uniqueness; a primary key guarantees uniqueness and usually has an index.

distinctions.label: Ordinary field
distinctions.text: Fields like name and email can contain duplicates; a primary key's values cannot repeat and cannot be empty.
